sentence_stem: Because the old man had lost his key,
correct_completion: he could not enter the house.
full_sentence: Because the old man had lost his key, he could not enter the house.
acceptable_variants: he had to wait outside in the cold.
he knocked on the neighbour's door.

options.text: he laughed loudly at the joke.
options.why_wrong: This does not follow logically from losing a key. The main clause must show the result of the lost key.

options.text: the window was open all night.
options.why_wrong: This describes the house but does not show the effect of losing the key.

options.text: he could not enter the house.
he was carrying a heavy bag.
options.why_wrong: This adds an unrelated detail and does not express the consequence of the cause given in the first clause.

explanation: After 'because', the first clause gives the cause, so the main clause must state the effect that follows from it.
translation: Ponieważ staruszek zgubił klucz, nie mógł wejść do domu.
